purpose: Strong no-LLM benchmark requested by Reviewer 2 for real-time PTO and energy-market interaction.

method.formulation: rolling two-stage stochastic mixed-integer linear program
method.first_stage: all executable scheduling, charging and V2G decisions before the declared information-revelation timestep
method.second_stage: scenario-specific recourse at and after the information-revelation timestep
method.rolling_policy: implement only the next executable interval, update observed state and the public scenario set, then solve again
method.physical_model: the unchanged app_rt.py bus, trip, charger, SOC, service and V2G model
method.objective: probability-weighted service-feasibility penalty plus PTO economic dispatch cost under the same tariffs
method.risk_measure: risk-neutral expected value in the primary benchmark; no CVaR tuning in the primary result

information_contract.input: a human-authored structured uncertainty set containing only ranges and asset/time references available in the public confirmed notice
information_contract.market_information: the same causal time-varying price trajectory and tariff schedule supplied to the other methods
information_contract.probability_basis: equal weights over the stated range endpoints because the 30-minute model grid cannot represent the 75- or 135-minute midpoints exactly and no empirical conditional frequency data are available
information_contract.probability_claim: stress-test weights, not calibrated real-world forecasts

cases.structured_public_basis: confirmed Bus 6 return-delay range of 60 to 90 minutes
confirmed EVSE 6-8 outage over timesteps 8-10; no unsupported uncertainty is invented
cases.interpretation: This cell is the prespecified deterministic-collapse check rather than a fabricated stochastic case.

cases.structured_public_basis: confirmed Bus 8 return-delay range of 120 to 150 minutes and the six unavailable chargers stated at timestep 30; the later correction is not leaked into this decision

primary_reporting: operational feasibility and service shortfall by realized case
altruistic full-day PTO cost subject to the same 50% baseline-revenue retention floor
Gurobi time, gap, nodes, CPU and memory
